signal: DeepSig showcased AI-native Open RAN and spectrum awareness integrations at MWC 2026, with PCTEL embedding its OmniSIG software and collaborations spanning NVIDIA and the AI-RAN Alliance.

email.body1:
Eric, saw DeepSig showcased AI-native Open RAN and spectrum tech at MWC 2026, with PCTEL embedding OmniSIG and collaborations across NVIDIA and the AI-RAN Alliance.

That kind of ecosystem momentum usually means more partners and accounts in play than BD can touch before they cool off. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for DeepSig off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for DeepSig.

As MWC and the new partnerships drive interest, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings DeepSig needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for DeepSig.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other deep-tech and wireless teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Eric, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding BD headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A run of partnerships and events is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a deep-tech wireless motion? I will tailor it to DeepSig either way.
